title: VITAL-LINK
summary: Multimodal LLM clinical workflow fusing chest X-ray, lung audio, and vital-sign telemetry via Gemini 2.0 Flash into an assisted-review interface.
problem: Multimodal health prototypes require careful assisted-review framing and useful consolidation of diverse inputs.
solution: A prototype brings image, audio, and vital-sign inputs into one review-oriented workflow with explicit model boundaries.
architecture: Case-study context: The prototype explores how image, audio, and vital-sign inputs can be brought into one bounded assisted-review workflow without turning a multimodal model into an unqualified clinical authority.
Multimodal intake: The prototype collects the three input types into one review context rather than isolated demonstrations. Components: Python, Flask.
Model-assisted review: Gemini 2.0 Flash supports the synthesis step while the interface keeps the workflow explicitly assistive. Components: Gemini 2.0 Flash.
Operator output: Charts and a generated document provide a review artifact for the prototype flow. Components: Chart.js, jsPDF.
The README describes a Flask application that combines chest X-ray, lung-audio, and vital-sign inputs in one review flow.
Gemini 2.0 Flash supports the model-assisted synthesis step; Chart.js visualizations and jsPDF reporting present a review artifact.
The README lists preconfigured sample cases; these are demo fixtures, not clinical validation.
outcomes: Assisted-review prototype combining image, audio, and vital-sign inputs in one bounded workflow.
Kept the scope at prototype and assisted review.
Avoided diagnosis, clinical validation, or treatment claims.
The portfolio describes an assisted-review prototype combining image, audio, and vital-sign inputs.
